title: Research Problems in Function Theory — Problem 4.1
exact_target: Must the maximum distance products have arbitrarily large peaks, how small can their growth be, and is the stated dyadic construction optimal? Also study the geometric mean of all prefix maxima.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2304001 (AMR-022-4001). CC BY 4.0.
Walter K. Hayman and Edward F. Lingham, \emph{Research Problems in Function Theory}, arXiv:1809.07200, 2018. Problem 4.1, its complete Update 4.1, and the relevant chapter notation.
